_comment: Copy next to a real document as <same-name>.truth.json in your BENCH_DIR (OUTSIDE git). Type every value exactly as printed. Money as numbers with a decimal point; dates YYYY-MM-DD; businessId and allocationNumber as digits only. Delete this _comment line. Lines are matched by sku: if the supplier prints no SKU, give each line a unique sku like L1, L2 … and the bench will count those lines as missing (accuracy only).
